AC amendment (gap-analysis): negative-test corpus immutability — the bad-verdict and malformed-YAML tests MUST pass the temp-copy path as the positional arg (never the real corpus), and the RED test must assert tests/runners/fixtures/corpus-index.yaml is byte-identical before/after the negative runs (no in-place mutation of the protected source of truth). The malformed-YAML case must exit non-zero via a caught yaml.safe_load failure (clean error message), not an uncaught traceback.
  Verify: grep -Eq 'cmp|sha256|md5|diff' tests/runners/test-corpus-schema.sh  (test includes a byte-identity check of the real corpus across the negative runs)
